title: Fit your words to the outlet
header_line: My analysis of one book on authority and personal brand. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: Which words would this readership use?

A student said that the core of her business is building people's brand equity and presence in the community that resonates with their target audience, through visuals that feed a targeted marketing strategy.
She said that she would not say it that way in a design magazine; it needs to be more fun and beautiful to start.
I said that in a financial business magazine the words are revenue growth and return on investment, while in an artistic journal they are different, so you adapt your words.
A student said that public relations is speaking positively about people you endorse and finding the right fit.
Write your core sentence once, then rewrite it for two readerships.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write it for a business reader.
Write it for a creative reader.
Write the words each reader uses.
Write where you will send each.

check.q: What did I say you do with your words?
What did a student say design readers want?
What words did I say a business magazine uses?

recap: One core, written for each readership.
